segments.text:
V. 1.
Father—This Simplicity of Appellation highly became the only begotten Son of GOD; to which a Believer then makes the neareſt Approach, when he is fulleſt of Love and humble Conſidence. The hour is come—The appointed Time for it; gloriſy thy Son—The Son glorified the Father, both before and after his own Glorification. When he ſpeaks to the Father, he does not ſtile himſelf the Son of Man.
